html:
UE 5.6 alpha.5 — engine-wide live session discovery

Plugin package 0.2.13-alpha.5 moves Unreal bridge registration out of each project's Saved/MajesticForge folder and into the current user's %LOCALAPPDATA%\MajesticForge\sessions folder. The engine plugin is enabled by default, and the bridge starts when its editor module loads. The MCP server discovers live sessions from the shared folder and checks the responding process; it does not choose a project from a previous session. The current project path is read from the live editor only when a project identity operation is requested.

The Codex ForgeMCP environment no longer sets a project-specific Unreal session directory. Blender and Unreal use the shared session folder by default. A user can set FORGE_SESSION_DIR for a deliberate shared override; the app-specific variables remain available for isolated testing and private deployments.

Validation

  • Python suite: 349 passed.
  • Ruff and Python bytecode compilation: passed.
  • UE 5.6.1 isolated UnrealEditor Development target: 29 actions passed, including both ForgeMCP modules. The build disabled only the unrelated Cargo plugin because its installed KitBash3dUsdTools module definition is missing.
  • Package: Artifacts/ForgeMCP-Unreal-Alpha-0.2.13-alpha.5-UE5.6.1-Win64.zip, SHA-256 08727410482f5d156f3aeaf834e232eea36c883ad39d58ad3d90ede1d22a83b9.
  • The packaged plugin loaded in a disposable UE project and registered to the shared user session folder. The isolated MCP subprocess found and authenticated its live session, forge_ensure_connected selected it explicitly, and the returned project identity matched the disposable test project.

Installation and live-editor acceptance

The engine package is staged but not installed yet. The user's UE 5.6 editor has the existing ForgeMCP module DLL loaded, so the engine installer must wait until that editor closes. After installation, start Unreal without a project first to verify that the engine plugin registers on editor launch; choosing a project later must not change the session discovery root. Restart the Codex MCP host after the configuration edit so it loads the current server source, which includes forge_ensure_connected.

The source and package build do not prove successful engine installation, a projectless visible Editor UI, or live auto-connection in the user's current app; those gates remain pending.
